narrative.text: Presents the first part of WHO Summary Table 1 (updated December 2025), summarizing routine immunization recommendations across children, adolescents, and adults for universally recommended antigens: RSV (maternal vaccine or long-acting monoclonal antibody), BCG, Hepatitis B, Polio, DTP-containing vaccine, Haemophilus influenzae type b (Hib), Pneumococcal conjugate vaccine (PCV), Rotavirus, Measles, Rubella, and HPV.

Presents the remainder of WHO Summary Table 1 (updated December 2025) covering regional, high-risk, and programme-specific antigens—Japanese Encephalitis, Yellow Fever, Tick-Borne Encephalitis, Typhoid, Cholera, Meningococcal, Hepatitis A, Rabies, Dengue (TAK-003), Malaria, Mumps, Seasonal Influenza, Varicella, and the off-label 1p+1 PCV schedule—followed by detailed antigen-by-antigen footnotes (1–24) summarizing the corresponding WHO position papers and SAGE updates.

Provides the introductory header and disclaimer for WHO's December 2025 Summary Table 1 on routine immunization recommendations, directing readers to the WHO position papers webpage and noting that cited ages and intervals guide national schedule development rather than direct clinical use.
